mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.finalization_operational_event ( event_type, attendance_day_id, incident_claim_version, department_id, department_name, attendance_date, first_failed_at, occurred_at, total_attempt_count, error_code, next_attempt_at ) SELECT 'FINALIZATION_RETRY_EXHAUSTED', day.id, #{incidentClaimVersion}, day.department_id, department.name, day.attendance_date, day.finalization_first_failed_at, #{occurredAt}, 6, #{errorCode}, #{occurredAt} FROM public.attendance_day AS day JOIN public.department AS department ON department.id = day.department_id WHERE day.id = #{attendanceDayId} AND day.status = 'SCHEDULED' AND day.finalization_failure_count = 6 AND day.finalization_claim_version = #{incidentClaimVersion} ON CONFLICT (event_type, attendance_day_id, incident_claim_version) DO UPDATE SET event_type = finalization_operational_event.event_type
mapper.select: UPDATE public.finalization_operational_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', delivery_attempt_count = delivery_attempt_count + 1, delivery_claim_version = delivery_claim_version + 1, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= #{now} RETURNING id, event_type, attendance_day_id, incident_claim_version, department_id, department_name, attendance_date, first_failed_at, occurred_at, total_attempt_count, error_code, delivery_attempt_count, delivery_claim_version
mapper.update: UPDATE public.finalization_operational_event SET status = 'RETRY', next_attempt_at = #{now}, lease_until = NULL, last_delivery_error_code = 'OPERATIONS_TELEGRAM_LEASE_EXPIRED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= #{now}
